about_the_game:
Voice of Chernobyl is a Multiplayer First-Person Shooter based in an apocalyptic world with tons of weapons to play with and that can be sold or purchased. There are many maps that vary from each other like the maps size or theme.


ARMOUR AND CONSUMABLES

With bolts (that can be earned per kill) you can use them to buy Armour which can benefit you by giving more mobility or more protection, or on Consumables that can help out in sticky situations or give you temporary effects

GAME MODES

There are currently 4 game modes in Voice of Chernobyl that are different from each other; Deathmatch | Team deathmatch | Melee fight | Zombie Infection. Each game mode requires at least 2 players to play

YOUR LOOKS

You can earn either a present or crate when a round ends and opening them can earn you a random cosmetic with a random effect or colour. Make your own personal character to distinguish from others or to look awesome when dead

HAVE A DANCING SESSION

Don't wanna kill? Want to show off your moves? By pressing G you can select which taunt to do and show your moves off, either to random people or to your friends after countless times of killing each other

LAGGING?

Don't worry! The options include tons of settings to enable or disable graphical effects, and you can change the games rendering system in there too! The game should work on most devices but by default it's on high settings, make sure to change your settings before joining a room incase you have a low-end device

AND MORE!

There's too much stuff to list in the store page! Play the game to find out other features there are, like gore that gives a satisfying feeling when you headshot someone



Want to give feedback? or you found any issues? Feel free to tell us! There are also other players in the server to talk to, or to play with

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains a lot of gore and blood, that can be disabled in the games options which disables gore and turns blood into confetti.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Celeron N3060 1.60GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics Card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game size will increase with upcoming updates, however minimum system requirements will remain same
